summary: Frontend-only visual/interaction regression for pastel card styling across 5 screens on 390x844 mobile viewport. All screens display the required 4-color cycling palette (red #FFB3BA -> pink #FFD6E8 -> yellow #FDF3B3 -> green #C8E6C9) with dark text (#0F172A titles / #475569 subtitles) and dark icons (#334155). All interactions verified: folder navigation, tap-to-play + MiniPlayer, 2px #2E7BBF blue border on playing track, Add-to-Playlist modal, playlist creation from modal, Library card, Playlist detail track & remove button. No blank screens, no rendering crashes. Deprecated packages detected: expo-av (SDK 54).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the expo-audio and expo-video packages to replace the required functionality.' Migrate audio playback to expo-audio. Reference: /app/frontend/app/contexts/AudioPlayerContext.tsx

Warnings: 'Route "./components/AddToPlaylistModal.tsx" is missing the required default export', same for MiniPlayer.tsx, constants/*.ts, contexts/*.tsx, utils/playlistStorage.ts. expo-router is scanning non-route files. Move helpers outside /app/ or add explicit route filtering. Reference: /app/frontend/app/components, /app/frontend/app/constants, /app/frontend/app/contexts, /app/frontend/app/utils

Console warnings: 'textShadow*' and 'shadow*' style props are deprecated, 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated', 'style.resizeMode is deprecated'. Refactor to consolidated 'textShadow'/'boxShadow' props, style.pointerEvents, and props.resizeMode. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:143-153 (heroImage resizeMode, heroTitle textShadow*), /app/frontend/app/collection/[id].tsx:94 (pointerEvents='box-none')

Console error: 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' Likely from react-native-draggable-flatlist internals; monitor for upstream fix. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (DraggableFlatList usage)

action_items: Migrate expo-av -> expo-audio (audio) and expo-video (video) per SDK 54 deprecation.

Move /app/frontend/app/components, constants, contexts, utils out of the app/ route tree (e.g. /app/frontend/components) to silence 'missing default export' warnings and prevent them from being registered as expo-router routes.
Update deprecated style props (textShadow*, shadow*, pointerEvents prop, style.resizeMode) to the new consolidated APIs.
OPTIONAL: consider slightly bumping subtitle contrast from #475569 to #334155 on the pastel yellow card (#FDF3B3) if strict WCAG-AAA is desired; current AA passes.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx has a duplicated useEffect (lines 28-30 and 32-34) both calling loadData() - one of them is dead code and should be removed.

Non-route helper directories (components/, constants/, contexts/, utils/) live inside /app/frontend/app/ where expo-router expects only route files; this is the root cause of the default-export console warnings. Please relocate.
PASTEL_COLORS constant is duplicated verbatim in 5 files (index.tsx, search.tsx, library.tsx, collection/[id].tsx, playlist/[id].tsx). Extract to a shared theme module for DRY compliance.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral playlist 'TEST_MyMix' via AddToPlaylist modal (stored in AsyncStorage). Persisted only in browser storage - no backend state modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ionicons on Expo web render as font glyphs (span with private-use unicode like \uf466, \uf10c, \uf8be), NOT SVG. To find/click an icon in Playwright, either (a) tap by coordinate from the screenshot, or (b) locate by textContent === '\uXXXX'. The top tab bar (Home/Search/Library/Favorites/Profile) is rendered at the TOP of the screen (~y=35), not the bottom. Bottom of the screen at y~720-780 is the MiniPlayer. AddToPlaylist modal's Create button label is 'Create & Add' (not just 'Create'). Alert.alert() maps to window.alert on web - install `page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept())` to auto-dismiss.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs found. Pastel styling patch is correctly implemented on all 5 target screens with proper color cycling by list index and readable dark text/icons. Playing-state blue border regression check passes.
